[SWS_DM_01086] Triggering for snapshot record storage (con- figured, with update)
⌈
If
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.typeOfFreeze-
FrameRecordNumeration is set to configured, DiagnosticFreezeFrame.up-
date is set to ’True’ and the configured DiagnosticFreezeFrame.trigger is ful-
filled, the DM shall collect and store, respectively update the snapshot record.
⌋
